description:
Bible Answers Live is a live call-in radio program where callers can have their questions answered directly from the Bible.
A dynamic 60-minute radio broadcast in which listeners like you are the program! 
You’ll get accurate, biblical answers to difficult Bible questions. Join Pastor Doug Sunday nights at 7:00pm Pacific. Call 1-800-GOD-SAYS during the broadcast to have your question answered live on the air! This program broadcasts live from 7:00 - 8:00 PM PST Sunday evenings. 


Broadcast Date: August/28/2022

Find more at http://www.amazingfacts.org

chapters.title: You Can Own Heavenly Real Estate for Free
Who Wrote the Book of Lamentations
Why Is There So Much Violence in the Old Testament in Joshua
How Do You Know God's Will
What Does It Mean in the Bible Where It Says the Word Does Not Die
Does God Call all of Us To Be Disciples
Do You Have To Be Baptized To Go to Heaven
Do We Know When Probation Closes
Finding Peace in a World of Worry What To Do with Trials and Difficulties
Why Are We Born with the Self Sinful Nature
